literal_meaning: চোখের ড্যাবড্যাব ভাব (আয়ত বিস্ফারিত ও ভাষাহীন চোখের অনুকরণ)
figurative_meaning_en: Wide-open and speechless eyes, indicating astonishment or surprise
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে অবাক হয়ে ড্যাবড্যাব করে তাকিয়ে রইল।
example_sentences_in_english: He stared with wide-open eyes in astonishment.
The children watched the show with gawking eyes.
note: This is an onomatopoeic expression mimicking the sound or state of wide-eyed staring in Bengali folklore and daily speech.
